body: While gender and racial biases in language models have been widely studied, anti-LGBTQ biases remain underexplored, particularly beyond English. Existing benchmarks often do not capture cultural and linguistic variation and rely on gender representations. This paper introduces a multilingual German-English benchmark dataset for the evaluation of anti-LGBTQ biases in language models. It combines community-sourced stereotypes from German-speaking queer individuals with a German translation of WinoQueer. The data is used to evaluate eight language models across sizes and architectures and explore mitigation through fine-tuning on community and progressive media content. Results show that language models reproduce anti-queer stereotypes, with variation across identities and models. Differences between the translated and community-based data highlight the importance of cultural adaptation for multilingual bias evaluation. Fine-tuning reduces bias on average, but not consistently across models and identities. Warning: This text contains examples of anti-queer hateful language and stereotypes.
summaryZh: 针对大模型中反LGBTQ偏见研究不足的问题，该研究构建了一个德英双语基准数据集。该数据集结合了德语区酷儿群体的社区来源刻板印象与WinoQueer的德语翻译版。通过对八个不同架构和规模的模型进行评估，研究发现模型普遍存在反酷儿刻板印象，且不同文化背景下的偏见表现存在差异。研究结果强调了在多语言偏见评估中进行文化适应的必要性，并探讨了通过社区内容微调来缓解偏见的有效性。

glossary.explanationZh: 反LGBTQ偏见，指模型输出中对性少数群体的歧视或刻板印象。
多语言评估，衡量模型在不同语言环境下的表现。
文化适应，指根据特定文化背景调整模型评估或训练策略。
刻板印象缓解，通过技术手段减少模型输出中的偏见。
